exposure: Intrathecal magnesium sulfate (MgSO4) as an adjuvant to bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women with mild pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) who were scheduled for elective caesarean sections.
finding: The addition of intrathecal magnesium sulfate to bupivacaine significantly prolonged the duration of postoperative analgesia and sensory block without causing additional side effects compared to bupivacaine alone.
followup_time: Approximately 200 minutes post-surgery for sensory block duration, with hemodynamic parameters observed at 1, 5, and 15 minutes.
